checked_scope: The constant highest-payoff-action criterion and existence of expected Cesaro limits for memory-one profiles.
checks: When no row attains the global maximum against every opponent profile, finite row count makes the uniform-opponent gap Δ strictly positive, independently of the proposed kernel.
Independent uniform first-copy opponent actions conditionally bound every focal mixture below M−Δ; a fixed maximizing second-copy profile achieves M.

A fixed memory-one kernel with these opponents induces a finite homogeneous chain. Bounded stochastic matrix powers exclude nontrivial unit-circle Jordan blocks, proving expected Cesaro convergence even for periodic/reducible chains. Constant maximizing rows suffice pointwise, including singleton opponent sets.
